Q: Multiple search-and-replace inside the same text A:

Stick with your regex, but wrap it in a loop:

Try these once and check it.

(reg)(text\d+.*?)(regtext3)

→

$1$3$2

…and repeat until stable.

Q: Warning when reading a Delta dataframe with Polars, but everything works A:

By now you have two ways to "solve" this: both ways remove the warning and basically speed up performance because the authentication method isn't attempted.

  1. set the environment variable (always works)

Code:

os.environ["AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED"] = "true"
  1. set the parameter in the storage_options (doesn't seem to work on the first execution which causes a delay of ~3seconds, but subsequently works for some reason)

Code:

df.write_delta(
  target=s3_path,
  overwrite_schema=True,
  mode="overwrite",
  storage_options = {
      "AWS_S3_ALLOW_UNSAFE_RENAME": "true",  # Required if we don't use a LockClient
      "AWS_REGION": "x",
      "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID": "x",
      "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": "x",
      "AWS_SESSION_TOKEN": "x"
  }
)

Q: Git clone/push issue: error: RPC failed; curl 16 Error in the HTTP2 framing layerB/s A:

Finally, I found a pretty simple solution using the SSH command for cloning. The step-by-step process is described below:

To fix this issue you need to use the SSH command given on GitHub, for example:

a) git clone git@github.com:demoUser138/Yo-B.git

b) But this requires adding a public key. click on the link given in the repo SSH section: add a new public key

c) Now for windows user open : C:/Users/<your system User for example Death is real truth>/.ssh

d) Now copy the code of id_rsa.pub (public SSH key file data) to the key section.(Refer below image)

e) Now click on the add SSH key button, it will ask password of your GitHub account, add it and it will get added successfully.

f) Now the first command will work flawlessly.

Note:

This will work for pull/push/commit as well.

You have to add your system's public SSH key file data. (You can easily search the path of the file over Google for Linux or other OS etc)

Note: Make sure that you have a good stable internet connection as well because multiple users faced it due to poor internet connection issue. In that case the above solution will may not work.
